# kinsta_sites (Data Source)

Lists every WordPress site of the company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinsta_sites" "all" {}

output "site_primary_domains" {
  value = { for s in data.kinsta_sites.all.sites : s.name => s.primary_domain }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sites` (Attributes List) The company's sites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites))

<a id="nestedatt--sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Site ID.
- `live_environment_id` (String) ID of the live environment.
- `name` (String) Site name.
- `primary_domain` (String) Primary domain of the live environment.
- `status` (String) Site status.
